featured_reviews.name: Shivkumar Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: ❌ Disappointing Experience – Poor Management and CommunicationI joined the 4 Fitness Gym in Kopar Khairane just two days ago, and I am already deeply disappointed with their service and management.Today, during my second session, I cut my workout short specifically to use the steam room. The standard time allowed is 20 minutes. However, just 10 minutes after my group entered, the steam machine was abruptly switched off from outside without any prior warning or announcement.We sat inside the dark room for several minutes waiting, only to realize the nozzles had completely stopped working. The irony is that no staff member bothered to inform us. When we questioned the housekeeping staff, they acted completely clueless before finally admitting that the gym owner had ordered the machine to be turned off early.This is incredibly unprofessional and unfair to paying members. If the gym only wanted to provide 10 minutes of steam today, that should have been communicated before we walked inside. Cutting off a facility mid-session without courtesy or explanation feels disrespectful. It has completely ruined my impression of this gym on only my second day.

featured_reviews.name: jack indusface
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Experience – Don’t Fall for Their Promises

We joined this gym mainly because it had less crowd and seemed comfortable. At the time of joining, they also promised a diet plan and a gym bag with the yearly membership. But honestly, that’s where the good part ended.

Within a week, when we asked for the diet plan, they suddenly asked for extra charges and completely denied ever offering it. The gym bag? Same story—“it’s in manufacturing, it will come soon.” A whole year passed, and we never received anything.

When we went for renewal, we again raised these issues. This time, the staff said they were not aware because the team had changed, but assured us that everything would be provided now. Unfortunately, nothing changed.

To make things worse, in the locker area, someone damaged the belt of our new bag. We complained to the reception staff, and she kept saying she would check the CCTV and inform the manager. We followed up for 2–3 days, but it was always the same excuse—no action, no update, nothing. No responsibility, no compensation.

Meanwhile, we could clearly see that gym bags were being given to other members, but for us, it was always “still in manufacturing.”

The management here is extremely unprofessional. They don’t care about your belongings, your concerns, or the promises they make. The only thing they care about is getting your money.

If you’re planning to join, don’t get trapped by the offers shown during admission—especially by the same reception staff. We made that mistake.

Think twice before joining. Not worth it at all.
